adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a transactional consistency issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the diff, the handler first commits attendees to the database via `prisma.booking.update` (lines 85-99), then calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` (line 165). If the calendar update fails, the attendees are already persisted in the database. The uniqueGuests filter (lines 68-72) checks against existing `booking.attendees`, so retrying with the same guests would filter them out as duplicates, preventing completion of the calendar update. This is a real atomicity/consistency bug where partial failure leaves the system in an inconsistent state.
